_comment: Engineering inventory for seven legacy shadow controls plus twenty-one mandatory baseline blockers. Classification values are implementation assessments, not bank risk ratings. No Argus, DLP, or pipeline mapping is called verified until the owning team supplies evidence.

rules.policyIntent: Prevent assistant-authored suppression or bypass of verification controls.
nonMatches: Audit or explain existing skipped checks
rules.remediation: Fix the failing test, lint, scan, or CI condition at its root cause.

rules.policyIntent: Prevent secrets or requests to hardcode secrets from reaching generated source or prompts.
nonMatches: Reference a secret by approved store name
Remove or rotate an exposed credential
rules.remediation: Use the approved secret store and rotate any exposed credential.

rules.policyIntent: Prevent assistant-driven disabling or waiver of security scanning.
rules.remediation: Fix the finding or route an exception through the security approval process.

rules.policyIntent: Prevent unsafe custom cryptography and weak-algorithm introduction.
nonMatches: Migrate to an approved cryptographic library
rules.remediation: Use the organization-approved cryptographic or authentication library.

rules.policyIntent: Prevent customer or regulated data from being submitted to a model.
nonMatches: Discuss data handling without including real records
rules.remediation: Replace real data with synthetic or irreversibly anonymized fixtures.

rules.policyIntent: Prevent instructions to reveal or transmit credentials and environment data.
rules.remediation: Use approved secret references and egress-controlled operational workflows.

rules.policyIntent: Prevent assistant-driven direct mutation of production data, deployments, or protected branches.
nonMatches: Operate in a non-production test environment
rules.remediation: Use the normal reviewed release, branch, and production-change process.

rules.policyIntent: Block requests to introduce an authentication or authorization bypass.
nonMatches: Fix or remove an authentication bypass
rules.remediation: Use the approved identity, test fixture, and authorization path without disabling access checks.

rules.policyIntent: Block prompts containing literal-looking exposed secrets.
nonMatches: Reference a secret by store name
Discuss rotation without including credential material
rules.remediation: Remove and rotate exposed credentials, then reference the approved secret store by name only.

rules.policyIntent: Block requests to introduce weak algorithms or custom cryptography.
nonMatches: Migrate to an approved cryptographic library
rules.remediation: Use the organization-approved cryptographic library and approved algorithms.

rules.policyIntent: Block requests to introduce, retain, or ship temporary debug logging.
rules.remediation: Use the approved structured logger and remove temporary diagnostic output before commit.

rules.policyIntent: Block requests to hardcode environment-specific or operational values.
nonMatches: Extract a hardcoded value into configuration
Introduce a named constant for a stable domain value
rules.remediation: Move operational values to typed configuration or a named constant with an approved default.

rules.policyIntent: Block requests to construct SQL by concatenating or interpolating user-controlled values.
rules.remediation: Use parameterized queries, prepared statements, or approved ORM bindings.

rules.policyIntent: Block requests to write credentials, authentication data, personal data, or request bodies to logs.
rules.remediation: Omit or redact sensitive fields and log only approved non-reversible identifiers.

rules.policyIntent: Block requests to hardcode or embed credentials.
rules.remediation: Retrieve the credential from the approved secret store by name.

rules.policyIntent: Block high-confidence customer, payment, and regulated identifiers in prompts.
rules.remediation: Replace customer data with synthetic or irreversibly anonymized fixtures.

rules.policyIntent: Block requests to reveal or transmit credentials and environment data.
nonMatches: Reference a credential by vault name
rules.remediation: Use approved operational workflows and refer to secret resources by name only.

rules.policyIntent: Block command injection and dynamic execution of untrusted input.
nonMatches: Use an argument-array API with an allowlist
rules.remediation: Use parameterized process APIs, allowlists, and no shell interpretation.

rules.policyIntent: Block XSS and template-injection authoring requests.
rules.remediation: Use framework output encoding and approved sanitization at the rendering boundary.

rules.policyIntent: Block SSRF, open-redirect, and path-traversal authoring requests.
nonMatches: Add destination allowlisting and canonical path checks
rules.remediation: Allowlist destinations and canonicalize paths within an approved root.

rules.policyIntent: Block unsafe object deserialization and XML external entity processing.
rules.remediation: Use schema-validated formats and parsers with dangerous features disabled.

rules.policyIntent: Block weakening of token storage, cookie, CSRF, CORS, and server-side identity controls.
rules.remediation: Use secure cookies, CSRF validation, restricted CORS, and server-side authorization.

rules.policyIntent: Block disclosure of internal errors and implementation details to clients.
nonMatches: Replace stack traces with safe error codes
rules.remediation: Return a business-safe error code and keep sanitized diagnostics server-side.

rules.policyIntent: Block prompt-policy tampering, governance bypass, and blanket tool approval.
nonMatches: Request a scoped permission through review
rules.remediation: Keep governance active and grant tools only the least privilege required for the task.

rules.policyIntent: Block explicit software-supply-chain weakening and unsafe dependency acquisition.
nonMatches: Upgrade or remove a vulnerable package
rules.remediation: Use approved registries, pinned lockfiles, integrity verification, and SCA review.

rules.policyIntent: Block explicit weakening of rate limits, timeouts, circuit breakers, and bounded resources.
nonMatches: Add rate limiting or a timeout
rules.remediation: Tune bounded-resource controls through reviewed configuration and operational evidence.

rules.policyIntent: Block silent error swallowing and false-success behavior.
rules.remediation: Recover explicitly or propagate a typed failure with sanitized diagnostics.

rules.policyIntent: Block type and lint suppression used to bypass a failure.
nonMatches: Fix the underlying type or lint violation
rules.remediation: Correct the type contract or lint violation and keep strict checks enabled.
